compile.globalConstraints:
- No kernel, launcher, worker, waves-module, publish-fold or kata-client changes, and no role file other than `fleet/roles/implementer.md` changes; the engine's own edit is one call site and one report key.
- Nothing here gates: the coverage reading, the disclosure ticket and the probe change no run's verdict — for the same tree, `tests.passed`, the gate receipt and the merge decision are what they were at BASE.
- No direct Anthropic API call, no `anthropic` SDK and no API key in any shipped or dev file: the probe is model-free, the coverage reading spawns `node` on sims and nothing else, and the ticket goes over the same edge-proxied GitHub REST the PR uses.
- Every sim keeps printing `ALL TESTS PASSED` on its last line and names no sibling sim; a `probe_*.mjs` never joins the bridge.

constraintChecks.cmd: git diff --quiet $ULTRA_BASE -- skills/ultrapowers/kernel fleet/launch.mjs fleet/run-worker.mjs fleet/run-waves.mjs fleet/run-main.mjs fleet/publish-fold.mjs fleet/kata-client.mjs fleet/roles/fix.md fleet/roles/reviewer.md fleet/roles/examiner.md fleet/roles/reconcile.md fleet/roles/resolver.md

llmDerives: waves[][].tier on the args-file wave entries (slots pre-emitted as null; the engine reads knobs ONLY from these inline entries — never a top-level launch key)

nothing for waves[][].testCmd — the per-task command is compiler-derived from the task's Proof `Test:` paths and pre-filled on the wave entries (run-wide testCmd is driver-derived — knob or detection — and already stamped in the args file and receipt)

nothing for bootstrapCmd — driver-derived from the target's lockfile/manifest (or the --bootstrap-cmd knob) and stamped in the args file and receipt, so validation, the engine and the gate share one value
nothing for review depth — it is plan-authored (**Review:** marker), pre-filled on the args wave entries
